decisions.rationale: The whole demonstrative-locative phrase directly attests in them. Keep it at grammatical d6; do not invent an isolated DI/them or a d5 compound headed by supplied In.
GSUM directly attests three. Capital Three is the printed start of the verse line after the introductory In them, not a source correction.
LAM directly attests paths and names the status of the three mental actions, explained by the following complete context.
BDUN directly attests seven, the seven bodily/verbal actions that also count as deeds.
LAS directly attests deeds. Its local noun role contrasts with the homographic case particle and is supported by the numerical predicate and following commentary.
KYANG directly attests as well and adds deed status to the seven. It does not independently own the earlier are predicate.

omissions.reason: NI topicalizes seven, and final YIN predicates the verse with an elliptical second English copula. English are occurs after Three before paths. Shared/elliptical predication does not justify moving NI or final YIN onto an exclusive first-clause atom; leave both unbanked rather than asserting absence.

The attested demonstrative-locative phrase In them is retained whole at d6. No separate demonstrative pronoun is inferred solely from a leftover English word, and the introductory comma remains source punctuation.
